'''2004 Mystic Visions Scott Lingrell LS Rebel Strike Team''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Scott Lingrell]] at [[2004 Mystic Visions]], finishing 1st; the list below is as posted on DeckTech by Scott "CRingwell" Lingrell (2004-08-01).<ref name="src">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=33370 Mystic Visions LS Winner]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20070211033548/http://www.decktech.net:80/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=33370&PHPSESSID=84d2b1152e98cb77a826b3278db9feed Internet Archive]</ref>
